module: Small editor manager that maintains the DecalRoad vertex cache: it initializes it for all the level's DecalRoads when the editor starts, and updates it when a prefab is "exploded" (unpacked) in the scene. No function is meant to be called by a modder.
notes: Calls editor.initializeLevelRoadsVertices() and editor.updateRoadVertices(object), functions provided by the editor (C++/Lua).

onEditorPrefabExploded.desc: Hook called when one or more prefabs are exploded in the editor. For each object of each group, if it is a DecalRoad, recomputes its vertices with editor.updateRoadVertices.

groups.desc: List of groups (SimGroup) coming from the prefab; each group exposes getObjects() (inferred from code).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called when the editor initializes: initializes the vertices of all the level's roads (editor.initializeLevelRoadsVertices).
